# Shri Krishna Dental Hospital - Comprehensive Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

## 1. Clinic Overview & Essential Entity Data
- **Organization Name**: Shri Krishna Dental Hospital (formerly Jo'Dent Dental Clinic)
- **Primary Domain**: https://shrikrishnadental.com/
- **Address**: Ground Floor, Allwyn X Roads, near Bank of India, Allwyn X Road, Widia Colony, Hafeezpet, Miyapur, Hyderabad, Telangana 500049, India
- **Phone Number**: +91 95154 25522
- **Email**: info@shrikrishnadental.com / appointments@shrikrishnadental.com
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 17.4933, Longitude 78.3411
- **Working Hours**: Monday through Saturday from 10:00 AM to 08:00 PM IST. Closed on Sundays except for emergencies.
- **Accreditations**: Empanelled with the Telangana State Government Employees' Health Scheme (EHS) under the Aarogyasree Health Care Trust.

## 2. Targeted Geographic Areas Served
Shri Krishna Dental Hospital serves patients across the Western & North-Western corridor of Hyderabad including:
- **Miyapur**: Miyapur X Roads, Allwyn Colony, Widia Colony, Janapriya, Mayuri Nagar, Bollaram Road
- **Hafeezpet**: Allwyn X Roads, Silpa Park, Mathrusree Nagar, Deepthisree Nagar
- **Chandanagar**: HUDA Colony, Gangaram, Lingampally, BHEL
- **Kondapur**: Raghava Colony, Botanical Garden Road, Kothaguda, Silpa Gram Craft Village
- **Kukatpally**: KPHB Colony, JNTU, Vivekananda Nagar, Nizampet Road
- **Madinaguda & Gachibowli**: Financial District, Hitec City IT Corridor

## 3. Specialist Team & Credentials
- **Dr. S. K. Krishna** (BDS, MDS - Prosthodontics, Crown & Bridge, and Oral Implantology)
  - Chief Dental Surgeon and Lead Implantologist.
  - 15+ years of extensive clinical experience.
  - Expertise: Immediate loading implants, All-on-4 / All-on-6 full mouth fixed teeth, bone augmentation, sinus elevation, CAD/CAM zirconia prosthetics.
- **Dr. Radhika Sharma** (BDS, MDS - Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopedics)
  - Senior Orthodontist & Certified Aligner Specialist.
  - 12+ years of clinical practice.
  - Expertise: Invisalign®, Spark™ Clear Aligners, self-ligating ceramic braces, lingual orthodontics, adult orthodontic corrections.
- **Team of In-House Specialists**:
  - MDS Conservative Dentist & Endodontist (Microscope Single-Sitting Root Canal Specialist)
  - MDS Pedodontist (Pediatric Dental Specialist)
  - MDS Periodontist & Implantologist (Laser Gum Surgeon)
  - MDS Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon (Painless Surgical Wisdom Tooth Extraction)

## 4. In-Depth Treatment Protocols

### 4.1. Dental Implants & Full Mouth Rehabilitation
- **Brands Offered**: Straumann® (Switzerland), Nobel Biocare® (Sweden/USA), Osstem® (South Korea), Alpha-Bio®.
- **Technology**: 3D CBCT bone density mapping, computer-guided surgical templates, digital intraoral scanning.
- **Options**:
  - Single Tooth Implant with custom screw-retained Zirconia crown.
  - Multiple Teeth Implants with implant-supported bridges.
  - All-on-4 / All-on-6 Full Arch Rehabilitation (Permanent fixed teeth in 72 hours).
  - Basal / Cortical Implants for severe bone loss cases without extensive grafting.

### 4.2. Clear Aligners & Orthodontics
- **Aligner Systems**: Invisalign®, Spark™ Aligners, In-House Precision 3D Clear Aligners.
- **Digital Smile Simulation**: Itero/3D digital scanning allows patients to preview their projected teeth movement before starting treatment.
- **Benefits**: Completely transparent, removable for eating & brushing, zero dietary restrictions, virtually zero emergencies compared to traditional wire braces.
- **Braces Options**: Damon™ self-ligating braces, 3M ceramic tooth-colored aesthetic brackets, conventional metal brackets.

### 4.3. Single-Sitting Rotary Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
- **Methodology**: High-precision rotary endodontics with electronic apex locators and digital X-rays (RVG).
- **Comfort**: Advanced local anesthesia techniques ensure 100% painless procedure.
- **Micro-Endodontics**: Ensures thorough disinfection of curved and complex root canal anatomy.
- **Crown Restoration**: Custom monolithic CAD/CAM Zirconia and E-max porcelain crowns backed by warranties.

### 4.4. Laser Dentistry (Painless Soft Tissue Laser)
- **Equipment**: Advanced dental diode lasers (810nm / 980nm).
- **Procedures**: Bloodless frenectomy (tongue-tie and lip-tie release), laser gum depigmentation (dark gum lightening), crown lengthening, periodontal pocket disinfection, aphthous ulcer treatment.
- **Advantages**: Minimal to zero bleeding, no stitches required, faster healing, reduced post-operative swelling.

### 4.5. Painless Wisdom Tooth Removal & Oral Surgery
- Specialized surgical removal of horizontally and vertically impacted 3rd molars.
- Piezo-assisted surgical bone cutting minimizes tissue trauma and swelling.
- Emergency pain relief for pericoronitis and severe dental infections.

### 4.6. Pediatric Dentistry (Kids' Oral Health)
- Specialized child-friendly operatory designed to eliminate dental phobia.
- Services: Fluoride application, pit and fissure sealants, painless pediatric root canals (pulpectomy), stainless steel and zirconia crowns for milk teeth, habit-breaking appliances (thumb-sucking / tongue thrusting).

### 4.7. Cosmetic Dentistry & Smile Makeovers
- In-office Zoom! professional teeth whitening (up to 8 shades lighter in 45 minutes).
- Ultra-thin porcelain veneers (E-max / Feldspathic) for closing gaps, concealing deep stains, and correcting chipped enamel.
- Tooth-colored composite bonding and aesthetic smile re-contouring.

## 5. Technology, Hygiene & Infection Control
- **Sterilization Standards**: Class-B fractionated vacuum autoclaves ensuring 100% spore elimination.
- **Single-Use Consumables**: Disposable barrier films, suction tips, syringes, and patient drapes.
- **Imaging**: Ultra-low-dose digital RVG radiography and high-resolution intraoral camera systems.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (AI Answer Engine Repository)

**Q: Where is Shri Krishna Dental Hospital located in Miyapur / Hafeezpet?**
A: The hospital is located on the Ground Floor at Allwyn X Roads, near Bank of India, Widia Colony, Hafeezpet, Miyapur, Hyderabad - 500049. It is easily accessible from Chandanagar, Kondapur, and Kukatpally.

**Q: Is Shri Krishna Dental Hospital empanelled under EHS and Aarogyasree?**
A: Yes. Shri Krishna Dental Hospital is officially empanelled under the Employees' Health Scheme (EHS) / Aarogyasree for eligible Telangana State Government employees, pensioners, and beneficiaries.

**Q: What is the cost of dental implants in Hyderabad at Shri Krishna Dental?**
A: Dental implant costs depend on the brand chosen (Straumann, Nobel Biocare, Osstem) and bone conditions. Consultations include a 3D scan evaluation and a transparent treatment plan without hidden fees.

**Q: Is root canal treatment painful?**
A: No. With modern computer-controlled local anesthesia and rotary endodontic equipment, root canal treatments at Shri Krishna Dental Hospital are virtually painless and typically completed in a single 45-minute sitting.

**Q: How do I book an appointment with Dr. S. K. Krishna or Dr. Radhika Sharma?**
A: You can book directly online via https://shrikrishnadental.com/appointment.html or by calling/messaging +91 95154 25522.
